purpose: Measure local transition errors before selecting further checkpoint edits
tail_calibration: Unweighted absolute OM4 increments pooled across calibration windows, separately by channel and wet/coast/interior region; exceedance rates are area weighted

screening_gates.increment_rms_ratio_distance_from_one: Must not increase relative to original

gate_aggregation: Equal-weight mean over transitions within each window, then channels in each group, then windows; evaluate separately in both modes on selection and new_local_test. Ratios are ratios of group mean metrics, not mean grid-cell ratios. No candidate is selected using the new_local_test.
limitations: Screening gates are engineering acceptance criteria, not physical laws or proof of physicality.
2019 windows were used in the previous local experiment; the 2014-2022 trajectory was already examined in aggregate. 2021 is new only to local candidate selection.
After AR state divergence, increment error is trajectory-increment discrepancy, not error against a simulator restart from the generated state.
Persistence controls affect only temperature and salinity at levels 15-18; remaining fields still use the model.
Teacher-forced first leads restart from true states and do not measure a continuous between-call seam.
Five-day averaged coarse fields cannot establish exact closed physical budgets from available state snapshots. This version does not claim budget closure.
Legacy forcing anomalies use full-record day-of-year climatology, matching the original training convention.
